findings.root_cause: REAL, IN-SCOPE EVALUATOR DEFECT: Candidate B's initial prompt (v1) allowed the judge to use outside biomedical/regulatory domain knowledge to infer a CONTRADICTED label when a claim added an overclaiming detail (e.g. 'fully validated brigatinib as a curative therapy' attached to a Phase-2-only claim) that the Evidence simply never addressed at all - the Evidence contains no efficacy/approval statement to actually conflict with. The correct label per contract Section 3 is PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED (an unsupported addition), not CONTRADICTED (which requires the Evidence to explicitly state the opposing fact).
findings.fix: grounding_eval/judge.py's _SYSTEM_PROMPT was extended with an explicit CRITICAL DISTINCTION section and a concrete example, telling the judge CONTRADICTED requires the Evidence's own stated content to be the source of conflict, never an inference from outside domain knowledge the Evidence does not contain.
findings.regression_check: development split rerun after the fix: 22/22 (up from 20/22); validation split (fresh cases, never touched during the fix): 5/5.

findings.category: NUMERIC_MISMATCH_MISSED / WRONG_ENTITY_MATCH (Candidate C only, not selected)
findings.root_cause: Candidate C's deterministic numeric precheck (grounding_eval/deterministic.py) used a naive digit-sequence regex that matched digits embedded inside alphanumeric identifiers (e.g. '03535740' inside 'NCT03535740', '1269' inside mutation code 'G1269A') and treated them as claimed numeric facts, causing false CONTRADICTED overrides on claims that were actually correct.
findings.fix: Tightened the regex to require non-alphanumeric boundaries on both sides (grounding_eval/deterministic.py::_NUM_RE), so digits embedded in identifiers/mutation codes are no longer extracted as claimed numeric facts.
findings.regression_check: Candidate C round 2: 16/22 (up from 11/22) - still below Candidate B's 22/22.
findings.residual_defect_not_further_fixed: The regex's symmetric letter-boundary requirement also excludes digits glued to letters on the EVIDENCE side (e.g. 'PHASE2' with no space), so the evidence-side numeric pool misses that value even when the claim states it correctly with a space ('Phase 2'), causing further false CONTRADICTED overrides (P7-F3-S/P, P7-M1, P7-F5-S/P/U remained wrong in round 2). NOT further fixed because Candidate C is not the selected architecture - Candidate B alone already meets every predeclared threshold, so no engineering effort was spent perfecting a candidate that will not be used.
findings.status: PARTIALLY FIXED, Candidate C not selected regardless

findings.root_cause: grounding_eval.deterministic._numbers_in compared raw regex-matched strings, so a claim stating "4" and Evidence stating "4.0" (same real value, different string formatting) were treated as a mismatch.

findings.root_cause: REAL, IN-SCOPE EVALUATOR DEFECT (zero-caveat pass): Candidate B's prompt (v2) still let the judge infer CONTRADICTED from a trial's status field via outside-domain reasoning ('a RECRUITING trial cannot have reported results yet'), for a claim asserting a response-rate result the Evidence's own fields (status/phase/conditions/interventions/sponsor/enrollment/dates) never mention at all. Per the contract, CONTRADICTED requires the Evidence's own stated content to be the source of the conflict - 'RECRUITING' never states 'no results have been reported'; that is an inference from general knowledge of how trials work, the same forbidden category F1 already targeted for a different scenario (added assertions), now recurring for a temporal/status scenario the F1 fix did not cover.
findings.detection: development-split case added during the zero-caveat hardening pass, predicted CONTRADICTED instead of gold UNSUPPORTED
findings.fix: grounding_eval/judge.py's _SYSTEM_PROMPT CRITICAL DISTINCTION section was extended with an explicit temporal/status-inference example forbidding exactly this class of reasoning.
findings.regression_check: Full re-verification after the fix, ALL on the unchanged frozen gold: original 22/22 dev, 5/5 validation, 9/9 held-out (all re-confirmed, not assumed); new v2 20/20 dev+validation (re-confirmed); new v3 case itself now correct (unsupported). No case that previously passed regressed.
